hero.lead: I'm a Computer Science student in Arles, building programs, games and websites to learn through hands-on projects.

about.title: About me
about.text: I've been passionate about computing since my first high school programming projects, and I'm now studying computer science in Arles. I am particularly interested in programming and game development. I enjoy inventing worlds, building gameplay mechanics and solving challenges along the way.

featured.title: Featured projects
featured.fantasy: A fantasy RPG featuring character classes, battles and random events.
featured.mancala: A strategy game to practice algorithms and graphical interfaces.
featured.blackjack: A card game project covering rules, events and scoring.

journey.1text: My first programming experiences with Python and small game projects.
journey.2text: Studying C++, databases, systems, web development and teamwork in Arles.
journey.3text: Improving The Fantasy, Mancala and this portfolio alongside university.
journey.4text: Keep improving, gain experience through internships and pursue further studies.

origins.title: Exploring computing my own way
origins.intro: I became interested in programming by creating my first games. Today I keep experimenting, imagining new mechanics and discovering different areas of computing.
origins.student: I'm studying computer science to improve my development skills, learn teamwork and discover new design approaches.
origins.idea: I like starting with a simple idea, building a prototype, testing what works and improving it. That's what I enjoy most about game development.
origins.explore: From Blackjack to Mancala and The Fantasy, each project helps me understand algorithms, interfaces and program structure.
